prior_observation: M6.3-0 produced only 2-4 strict-near A/B events per bonded arm over 12 seeds and 300 ticks; no specific A/B effect. This motivated fixed density/duration increase, not optimization after examining M6.3-1 results.
hypothesis: With original ALife physics, increasing encounter opportunities may reveal motif-specific production of new material-independent chains near an intact template; a difference can still be spatial/kinetic rather than hereditary.
scope: Deliberately synthesized four-atom motif at tick 0, no replicator or genotype, no engine/RNG/detector edits.

model.placement: For fixed density/seed, 4 scaffold cells and initial non-scaffold positions/species are identical across all arms, same state of sequential PCG64 after placement. Background placed without replacement from free cells, using the existing M6.3-0 generator.
model.energy: All five arms have exactly 3 bonded scaffold edges with the same total species composition and the same dissipated initial formation energy. S0/S1 initial energies differ by species but each arm has two of each, preserving total ledger.

primary_measure.event: First observation of a material set of EXACTLY four non-scaffold particle IDs with a canonical exact tree signature matching target motif; deduplicate by (signature, sorted particle IDs) across all ticks.
primary_measure.near: At least one particle of that new component at toroidal Manhattan distance <=2 from any fixed scaffold site AT FIRST APPEARANCE.
primary_measure.strict: Exclude any candidate with a constituent that has ever occupied a bonded component containing any scaffold ID, including the current tick.
primary_measure.active_template: Scaffold is intact ONLY if a connected component of exactly IDs 0,1,2,3 has the initial arm's exact signature and exactly 3 bonds at the observation tick.
primary_measure.outcome: Counts of strict near new A/B events while source scaffold intact; C events are separately described as an isoenergetic bond-control motif.
primary_measure.survival: Sum of intact scaffold ticks; report per-run first failure and periods of regrowth, not just final intact status.
primary_measure.exposure: Count free S0 and S1 particles adjacent (toroidal Manhattan distance 1) to any scaffold site, separately while scaffold intact and inactive, accumulated across ticks; these are potential encounters, not bond-forming reactions.
primary_measure.background: Count strict distinct new A/B/C elsewhere (including while scaffold inactive), total bond formations/breakage, hash, RNG fingerprints, stored energy and ledger.
primary_measure.forbidden: No deliberate daughter construction; do not call an association causal replication.

analyses.arm_comparison: At each density, compare (A_near-B_near) between source A and B, and separately between A_reverse and B_reverse on the SAME 16 seeded backgrounds; C is a third fully bonded, isoenergetic motif-sham with different sequence. Present raw absolute counts and normalized per 1000 intact exposure site-ticks, without treating adjacent seed trajectories as identical RNG draws.
analyses.density_comparison: Compare event counts, survival and exposure separately between baseline and enriched. Do not pool densities without labels.
analyses.gate_power: Only consider motif-specific effect evaluable if for enriched density each of four A/B orientation arms has >=8 strict near A+B events while scaffold intact AND at least 8/16 seeds have intact scaffold >=100 ticks in every tested arm.
analyses.gate_specificity: Only mark 'screen_signal_for_followup' if gate_power true and source-matched motif is more frequent in >=11/16 paired seeds for both A and B conditions and in both reverse orientations, using raw strict near counts; no reweighting or alternative outcome selected after inspection.
analyses.decision: A signal calls for new independent preregistered causal validation; otherwise 'underpowered_or_no_detectable_specificity'. Never call self-replication or authorize a physics change.
analyses.negative_controls: C bonded four-particle chain of same composition, length and energy, plus orientation reversal for A/B. No unbonded controls, because their initial ledger was not isoenergetic in M6.3-0.
analyses.no_p_hacking: Do not adjust densities, seeds, duration, radius, protocol, classification, arm set or thresholds after outcomes. Revise only under a different version with a new independent seed list.
reported_confounds: Species position ordering affects geometry and local affinity even with same overall composition
Scaffold may disintegrate; events after disintegration must not support templating
A/B/C do not guarantee equal encounter surface per species
Sequential RNG can diverge after state-dependent candidate counts
Sites are fixed; window distance is spatial association, not lineage

integrity.reproducibility_replay: Repeat one independently reconstructed source A arm per density and compare hash + counts + event trace.
integrity.dataset: campaigns/m6_3_1/results.json created by GitHub Actions, includes all 160 runs, zero runs and full protocol SHA.
integrity.never_overwrite: campaigns/m6_3_0 protocol/results and any M6 manifest/results
